title: Shadow box 11x14
text: Shadow box 11x14. I purchased this 11x14 shadows to lay flat on the table with stuff in it - and it works just as I had hoped.  You have options for glass or no... and it is quite sturdy. product_metadata.title: Love-KANKEI Shadow Box Frame 11x14 Shadow Box Display Case with Removable Glass Window and Soft Linen Back Memory Box for Memorabilia Photos Awards Medals Weathered Black
features: Premium material - This 11×14 deep shadow box made of solid wood frame, 3 mm thick high-definition tempered glass, and soft linen backboard with 8 fixing pins can perfectly protect your cherished photos or collectables.

Two ways to display - Inside the shadow box frame is a removable glass and an inner frame, so you can flatten the glass against the backboard for photos and flat items, or put the glass in the front of the box and the inner frame flush against the backboard for 3-D items.

Memory box - This memory box frame will display and protect your photos, wedding bouquet, handicrafts, valued clothing, wine corks, keepsakes, etc. Showcase and preserve your precious moments and memory.

Easy to use - With 2 saw tooth hanging hooks on its back this pretty rustic wall shadow box can be stable wall-hanging, or just stand on a tabletop. And 4 buckles for easily opening the backboard allow you easily update your display as often as you want.
Perfect decor - This weathered black wood shadow box designed in modern, simple and elegant style would be a great addition to any home decor.
